Visions and Values
One team, One vision.
Excellence through respect, opportunity, creativity and challenge.
be safe, be respectful, be ready!
We held a competition for the children to design four pictures to depict our Vision and Values of respect, opportunity, creativity and challenge. The winning entries were then made into mascots for our Vision and Values certificates. We present these weekly at our V & V assembly. Our aim is for the children to try to obtain all four certificates

Welcome
A Message from the Head Teacher
Welcome to Edgebury Primary School.
The purpose of our website is to inform parents, pupils and visitors about the school’s policies, activities, events and of the standards that we endeavour to achieve in our teaching and learning.
All of the staff and governors are united in our commitment to the continuous improvement of the quality of teaching and learning through collaborative professional development. We recognise every child as an individual, and we endeavour to support the academic and personal development of all children who attend Edgebury Primary School. We encourage children to have a sense of purpose and responsibility, and to take pride in their achievements and to see value in the achievements of others.
Our vision is rooted in the values: one team, one vision – excellence through Respect, Opportunity, Creativity and Challenge, forming the acronym Edgebury ROCCs. We promote tolerance and acceptance for all, benevolence, forgiveness and excellent behaviour for learning.
At Edgebury we welcome parents and carers to take as wide an interest and involvement as possible, because we know that children make faster progress when we work in partnership.
Seeing ourselves as part of a wider community we work in a school improvement focused partnership with primary schools: Poverest, Southborough and Downe, which along with Edgebury form the AFACT Group. We also endeavour to develop existing and new opportunities to work with people and institutions across London and internationally.
We hope that you enjoy exploring our website to see our record of Edgebury Primary School as we continue to develop and evolve. Thank you for taking an interest in our school.
Matthew Velada-Billson

pageCache.text:
Amber After- School, Breakfast and Holiday Club
The Amber after-school, breakfast and holiday club officially began on Monday 13 April 2026! Our previously provided wraparound service is now in- house.
Amber is staffed by Christine, Lucy and Shade and overseen by the Edgebury Senior Leadership Team to ensure it follows the Edgebury Way in its ethos, values and behaviours. A selection of hot and cold breakfast items and hot and cold afterschool snacks are available and is provided by Harrisons who also provide our school lunches.
Breakfast club runs from 7.30am until 8.45am and afterschool club runs from the end of the school day until 6pm with 45 spaces available in each session. Breakfast club costs £9.20 per session and afterschool club costs £19.00. During the school holidays, the holiday club will run from 8.00am until 5.30pm and will cost £35 per day.
We accept a variety of payment methods including bank transfer, card payments, childcare vouchers and Tax Free Childcare. If you are using Tax Free Childcare, please ensure that you have linked us to your account as a provider using Edgebury Primary School with postcode BR7 6BL.
We accept the following childcare vouchers:
Pluxee (Sodexo) - please quote Carer ID 923458
Edenred - please quote account number P21373504
We are in the process of registering with Computershare. We will share these details once we have completed the registration process.
If you need to contact Amber, please call the club mobile on 07927 909772.
To book your place, please visit https://edgebury.magicbooking.co.uk and select "forgot password" using the email you use for School Gateway and receive school emails on.
